extension.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

next_steps: 1. Put `extension` into capabilities.extensions of your Agent Card, replacing any existing https://docs.concordium.com/a2a-extensions/concordium-badge/v1 entry; delete any top-level `concordium` block.
2. Optionally add `registrations_entry` to the top-level `registrations` array (ERC-8004 discoverability).
3. Host the card at agent_uri, then hash the SERVED bytes: curl -s <agent_uri> | sha256sum

4. Pin the hash on chain: build_set_agent_uri { network, token_id, metadata_hash_hex, sender } (REST: GET /v1/build-set-agent-uri/<badge>?metadata_hash_hex=...) → sign with the owner wallet → submit (gasless via the sponsor service). Zero-gap variant: host at a new versioned URL and pass agent_uri + metadata_hash_hex together.
5. Confirm: GET https://agent-registry-mcp.concordium.com/v1/check-badge/JyP9UYj3AwBDfz2yHCMgx → badge_valid, extension_conformant and verification_present all true, issues [].
